doc_files_kind_payload_check.name: doc_files_kind_payload_check
doc_files_kind_payload_check.value:
("doc_files"."kind" = 'text' AND "doc_files"."yjs_doc_id" IS NOT NULL AND "doc_files"."storage_key" IS NULL)
          OR
          ("doc_files"."kind" = 'blob' AND "doc_files"."storage_key" IS NOT NULL AND "doc_files"."yjs_doc_id" IS NULL)
          OR
          ("doc_files"."kind" = 'folder' AND "doc_files"."yjs_doc_id" IS NULL AND "doc_files"."storage_key" IS NULL)
